d:
Bharat-pakistan sima aur panjab se sate rajasthan ke shrigangangar zile men in dinon hava men sans lena mushkil hota ja raha hai. shahar ho ya ganv, dur tak logon ko dhundh ki ek moti chadar dikhaee deti hai. divali ke bad se hi yahan pradushan ka star lagatar chinta ka vishay bana huaa hai. kaee maukon par alag-alag vebsaiton ke eyar kvaliti indeks (ekyuaaee) men is shahar ne duniya ke pradushit shahron ki suchi men shirsh par jagah banaee hai.
Riport aur shut mohar sinh mina
